name: Best Western on the Beach
description: Welcome to the only major-chain beachfront hotel in the Gulf Shores, Alabama. Located on the white-sand shores of one of America's most beautiful beaches, the Best Western on the Beach is your tropical vacation destination, offering all the comforts of home with exceptional value for your dollar. Breathtaking Beachfront Views Marvel at uninterrupted views of the Gulf of Mexico from your private balcony. Relax on a plush, pillow-top bed. Stay connected with free high-speed wireless Internet. Catch a flick on a 42" flatscreen TV. At the Best Western on the Beach, our clean, modern Gulf Shores accommodations offer all the comforts of home and all the beauty of the beach at rates that will leave you with plenty to spend on the area's world-class attractions. Our convenient onsite amenities and services offer a complete vacation experience. Start your day with the best breakfast in Gulf Shores at our onsite Island Pancake House. Soak up the sun in our outdoor pool, cool off in our indoor pool, or relax in our hot tub. Host your wedding or special event on our spacious beachfront or in our 50-person meeting facility. All the while, you can stay connected with free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Our hotel's location puts you within walking distance some the most popular things to do in Gulf Shores including top-tier restaurants, fishing charters, and outdoor adventures. Within easy driving distance, you'll find a dozen award-winning golf courses, a world-class zoo, five-star spas and much more.
